run_experiment_rq1: run the RQ1 experiment to measure how often an LLM performs the first hop of reasoning while processing two-hop prompts
run_experiment_rq2: run the RQ2 experiment to measure consistency between multi-hop and single-hop output probability distributions after patching
calculate_internal_entity_recall: calculate and store internal entity recall scores for target tokens in model residual streams
apply_residual_stream_patching: apply activation patching to model residual streams to measure causal effects on consistency scores
generate_completions_and_evaluate: generate model completions and evaluate them against ground truth answers for fact types
